passage.text: Emma, I have great news. I got the job!
passage.reading: ˈɛmə, aɪ ˈhæv ˈɡreɪt ˈnuːz. aɪ ˈɡɑːt ðə ˈdʒɑːb!

passage.text: Remember the language school for kids that I told you about?
passage.reading: rɪˈmɛmbər ðə ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ˌskuːl fər ˈkɪdz ðæt aɪ ˈtoʊld juː əˈbaʊt?

passage.text: They called me this morning and offered me a position as an English teacher!
passage.reading: ðeɪ ˈkɔːld miː ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ ənd ˈɔːfərd miː ə pəˈzɪʃən əz ən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈtiːtʃər!

passage.text: I had three interviews in two weeks, and I was so nervous before each one.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈhæd ˈθriː ˈɪntərvjuːz ɪn ˈtuː ˈwiːks, ənd aɪ wʌz soʊ ˈnɜːrvəs bɪˈfɔːr ˈiːtʃ ˈwʌn.

passage.text: After the last interview, I didn't hear anything for ten days, so I was sure that they didn't want me.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ðə ˈlæst ˈɪntərvjuː, aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈhɪr ˈɛniθɪŋ fər ˈtɛn ˈdeɪz, soʊ aɪ wʌz ˈʃʊr ðæt ðeɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈwɑːnt miː.

passage.text: When they called, I was so relieved that I almost cried.
passage.reading: wɛn ðeɪ ˈkɔːld, aɪ wʌz soʊ rɪˈliːvd ðæt aɪ ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈkraɪd.

passage.text: All those years of studying and volunteering have finally paid off!
passage.reading: ˈɔːl ðoʊz ˈjɪrz əv ˈstʌdiɪŋ ənd ˌvɑːlənˈtɪrɪŋ hæv ˈfaɪnəli ˈpeɪd ˈɔːf!

passage.text: My start date is June 1, so I have three weeks to prepare.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈstɑːrt ˌdeɪt ɪz ˈdʒuːn ˈfɜːrst, soʊ aɪ ˈhæv ˈθriː ˈwiːks tə prɪˈpɛr.

passage.text: I'm going to buy some new work clothes and plan my first lessons.
passage.reading: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈbaɪ sʌm ˈnuː ˈwɜːrk ˈkloʊðz ənd ˈplæn maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈlɛsənz.

passage.text: Mom and Dad are so proud, and Fah says she wants to be my first student!
passage.reading: ˈmɑːm ənd ˈdæd ər soʊ ˈpraʊd, ənd ˈfɑː ˈsɛz ʃiː ˈwɑːnts tə bi maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈstuːdənt!

passage.text: I knew you would get it. You're going to be a great teacher.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈnuː juː wʊd ˈɡɛt ɪt. jʊr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə bi ə ˈɡreɪt ˈtiːtʃər.

passage.text: Let's video call this weekend so you can tell me everything!
passage.reading: ˈlɛts ˈvɪdioʊ ˌkɔːl ðɪs ˈwiːkɛnd soʊ juː kən ˈtɛl miː ˈɛvriθɪŋ!
